items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: told the secretary, Mr. Power and the president, Mr. Gossett

ctx.x: When that band split up, who stayed with you? Which ones stayed with you and which ones went with Sillis?

Well, our band, we played at the Temple Roof Garden on a Wednesday night. Sillis Stain, the two Mareros and Paul Baum. They had a morning meeting. See? And the band, that's where they pulled out for me. Well, Lewis Madison, he was out among them and he heard of me. He called me up at 4 o'clock in the morning and he told me what they had done. But they had went out to Southern Yacht Club and told the secretary, Mr. Power and the president, Mr. Gossett, that I had quit playing music and turned everything over to…
Do you use shots on trumpet? Shots.
